title: Elevated 5xx errors from downstream API rate limiting
description: Checkout authorization is failing with 502 Bad Gateway because the fraud-check-partner API is rate limiting us: its 429 rate has jumped to 64% of calls while our traffic held steady at ~145 req/s against the partner's newly-enforced 100 req/s limit. Logs directly prove the 429s and our resulting 502s; whether the partner actually lowered its limit (vs. our traffic rising) remains reporting-level unless their changelog is independently checked.
